# IG-Only Analysis: What the Ranking Can (and Cannot) Tell Us About Ki-67 Regulation

## First, the honest limits of this evidence

Before interpreting, I must flag what this ablation condition provides: **unsigned, cell-averaged IG magnitudes** from an MLP. I have (1) no direction of effect (a top feature could push Ki-67 up or down), (2) no per-cell attribution distribution (opposing effects in different cells are averaged away), (3) no conditional logic or subgroup statistics, and (4) no confirmation of what "dual-gated" Ki-67 means operationally (likely a protein-level IF gate, with *MKI67* transcript excluded from the features — it is absent from the list). Any hypothesis I form must therefore be **program-level**, and directionality must be stated as biological prior, not finding.

The score distribution also matters: the top ~10 features (0.036–0.076) form a modest head ~2–4× above the tail, while ranks ~50–500 span only 0.021→0.009 (~2.3×). The model spreads credit across many correlated transcripts; only the head supports specific claims.

## What the head of the list actually contains

Counting directly from the provided ranking:

- **Ribosome/translation machinery dominates.** 9 of the top 20 and ~16 of the top 50 features are ribosomal proteins or translation factors (RPLP0, RPS18, RPS27, RPS3A, RPS7, RPL41, RPL34, RPL39, RPS29, RPLP1, RPL21, RPS11, plus PABPC1, NOP56, EIF5A, EIF1), versus ~13% of the full 500-gene panel — a real enrichment, not a panel-composition artifact. The acidic stalk proteins RPLP0/P1/P2 all rank in the top 120. mRNA-processing factors (HNRNPA2B1, HNRNPU, SNRPD2) and nucleolin (NCL, #84) reinforce a "RNA-handling capacity" theme.
- **Biosynthetic metabolism and iron:** FTH1 (#4), ALDOA (#12), GLUL (#16), COX8A (#20), PKM (#28), ASS1 (#30), SDHA (#37), NDUFS5 (#41) — glycolysis, oxidative phosphorylation, nitrogen (glutamine/arginine) handling, iron storage.
- **Spindle/cytoskeleton:** TUBB4B (#9), TUBA1C (#11), TUBB (#101), CTTN, ANLN, MYL6.
- **Proliferation-associated non-ribosomal genes:** PTMA (#1), CKS2 (#3), HDGF (#5), PTMS (#34), CDK2AP1 (#39), H2AX (#53).
- **Conspicuously *absent* from the head:** canonical cell-cycle effectors (CDK1 #234, CKS1B #171, BUB3 #116, AURKAIP1 #168, MYBL2 #335, STMN1 #385, TK1 #405 — only CKS2 breaks in), and **replication-dependent histones: zero in the top 50** (highest is the damage-associated variant H2AX at #53), while **~24 of the bottom 50 ranks are H2AC/H2BC/H3C/H4C/H1 genes** (~8% of panel overall — a ~6× enrichment at the bottom). Caveat: many textbook proliferation genes (TOP2A, PCNA, MCMs, cyclins, PLK1, AURKA) are not in the 500-gene list at all, so their non-importance cannot be assessed.
- Mid-list luminal/identity genes (AR #55, ZNF703 #67, XBP1 #85, MUCL1 #17, AZGP1 #48, WFDC2 #76, KRT8, CD24) hint that between-subtype composition may contribute to the ranking — a confound I cannot exclude from these data.

## Narrative and single best hypothesis

Denied the trivial *MKI67* transcript as input, the model appears to rediscover Ki-67's biological anchor. Ki-67 is an interphase nucleolar protein implicated in ribosomal RNA synthesis, and a perichromosomal/mitotic chromosome coat. The features that most strongly determine its status here are precisely the machinery that **builds a proliferating cell**: ribosomal proteins and translation factors (protein-synthesis capacity), energy and nitrogen/iron metabolism (biomass and energy supply), and tubulins (mitotic readiness). PTMA as the single top feature is coherent: prothymosin-α is an acidic, nucleolar-associated, MYC-inducible chromatin-decondensing factor whose expression is a long-established generic correlate of proliferation rate — functionally a smaller sibling of Ki-67's own biology. Meanwhile, the mid-to-low ranks of cyclin-CDK machinery and the near-zero attribution of replication-dependent histones suggest the Ki-67 gate tracks a cell's **cumulative biosynthetic growth state rather than its instantaneous S-phase transcriptional identity**.

**Hypothesis:** In these breast cancer cells, Ki-67 status is a readout of — and mechanistically coupled to — a MYC/mTOR-type ribosome-biogenesis/biosynthetic growth program; the high-attribution features jointly encode protein-synthesis capacity, metabolic/iron supply, and spindle readiness, and Ki-67 varies with the aggregate output of this program rather than with any single cell-cycle regulator or S-phase marker.

## Established knowledge vs. new mechanism

This is **mostly (a) confirmatory**: the Ki-67–nucleolus/rRNA link is textbook (Scholzen & Gerdes, *J Cell Physiol* 2000; chromophore-assisted Ki-67 inactivation inhibiting rRNA synthesis — Rahmanzadeh et al., *Cell Prolif* ~2007, cited from memory; Ki-67 as a mitotic chromosome "surfactant" — Cuylen et al., *Nature* 2016), as is ribosome biogenesis as the core proliferation program (Pelletier et al., *Nat Rev Cancer* 2018). The **(b) novel, testable elements** are: (i) in a spatial, protein-gated setting, translation-machinery transcripts predict Ki-67 far better than S-phase/histone or cyclin-CDK transcripts — i.e., the gate marks "growth" more than "cycle phase"; (ii) PTMA is the single strongest transcriptomic correlate of Ki-67 status in this system.

**Testable predictions:** (1) POLR1 inhibition (e.g., CX-5461), mTORC1 inhibition, or MYC knockdown lowers Ki-67 protein before/with cell-cycle exit; (2) PTMA knockdown reduces Ki-67 protein/*MKI67*, and PTMA/*MKI67* are co-regulated by MYC (ChIP); (3) in held-out data, a ribosomal/translation score predicts the Ki-67 gate ≥ a cell-cycle score (CDK1/CKS1B/BUB3/STMN1/TK1/MYBL2) and ≫ a histone score; (4) if the ribosomal signal is a cell-size/total-RNA artifact, regressing out per-cell total counts collapses those ranks — if it survives, specific coupling is supported; (5) Ki-67-high cells should show elevated ribosomal-program expression independent of luminal identity genes; if identity genes dominate instead, subtype composition (not proliferation regulation) explains the ranking.

## What this IG-only condition cannot deliver

No decision rules, direction, or subgroup structure were available, so the hypothesis is necessarily program-level; the flat mid-list indicates distributed, redundant importance where a classifier stage would be needed to extract crisp gating logic. Whether the classifier stage adds biological specificity beyond this narrative cannot be judged from this condition alone. Signed IG/SHAP, per-cell attribution distributions, subgroup breakdowns, and a total-count normalization check would materially raise confidence.
